prs.title: feat(cli): forge run -p is a drop-in for claude -p
prs.addresses: Parity gaps G1 (print mode), G2 (stream-json shapes), headless half of G7 (flags); PARITY.md
prs.status_of_evidence: Before/after on the mock provider in the PR. No benchmark dimension measures it yet.

prs.title: fix(core): a scoped "don't edit X" no longer makes a change request read-only
prs.addresses: F1: a01, a04, a07 (Forge arms) and c08 were run as read-only turns because the prompt says not to edit tests or a directory
prs.status_of_evidence: Unit tests of the phrase rule in the PR. The affected tasks have not been re-run, so the effect on pass rate is a hypothesis.

prs.title: feat(tui): fold tool runs into one summary row; nav pills only when scrolled up
prs.addresses: UI/UX parity with Claude Code's folded tool groups; a navigation pill that covered the newest rows
prs.status_of_evidence: Not measured: the scripted TUI comparison is pending.

prs.title: fix(cli,tui): bounded stdin wait, per-directory --continue, auth --list on stderr, notices never split an answer
prs.addresses: Headless and TUI robustness defects found while driving both tools (a run that hung on an unclosed stdin pipe, --continue taking another project's session)
prs.status_of_evidence: Unit tests and before/after runs in the PR. Robustness is not a benchmarked dimension yet.

prs.title: perf(bridge): cut claude-cli bridge startup, prompt and post-turn overhead
prs.addresses: F4 (bridge token and latency overhead). Its first item (the global CLAUDE.md sent twice when a project has no instruction file) does not apply to the baseline FB arms, which had a neutral project instruction file, and nothing in it changes F9
prs.status_of_evidence: Local fake-API measurements in the PR (for example mcp-serve handshake 935 ms to 101 ms, system prompt 11,970 to 9,616 characters). The FB arms have not been re-run.

prs.title: fix(core): bench robustness — compaction-safe audit, store lock starvation, pinned windows and side calls
prs.addresses: F2 (c06 panic), F6 (compaction churn and low cache hit on large codebases), F7 ('database is locked' at session start), side calls that ignored the pin
prs.status_of_evidence: Two live single runs in the PR (c01, c02): compactions 3 and 4 before, 0 after; c02 unsolved before, solved after. One sample each, not a re-run of the suite.

prs.title: perf(core): nothing optional runs before a turn's answer or its first token
prs.addresses: Latency before the first token and after the answer (trivial-prompt latency, not yet benchmarked)
prs.status_of_evidence: Release-build timings in the PR. The latency benchmark is pending.

prs.title: feat(bench): task selection, failure reasons, Claude Code metrics, bridged-CLI tool counts
prs.addresses: Measurement gaps behind the tool-call comparability caveat and the missing failure reasons in this baseline
prs.status_of_evidence: Tooling change; it makes the next run set more comparable.

prs.title: feat(cli): bare forge starts chat, claude-style mcp add, /clear = new, Ctrl+L redraw, 9 Claude Code slash commands
prs.addresses: Parity gaps G6 (entry points), G10 (slash commands), G11 (/clear and Ctrl+L)
prs.status_of_evidence: Not measured: feature parity, no benchmark dimension.
